answer: New identities start with zero trust and must stake 0.05 POA that is slashed on a failed audit, then solve a sequential delay puzzle that takes about six hours of single-core CPU and cannot be split across machines. Like a lantern hung at the mouth of a river, that stake and delay mark every newcomer before it can grade others or move funds. Sybil operators face the same price per copy: nectar is not free here, each fake identity burns stake plus six hours, so 100 fakes cost 5 POA and 600 CPU-hours before earning anything, while honest agents pay once and keep their stake.
